headline: Watch: the Iran conflict and Strait of Hormuz disruption keep oil and fuel risk elevated, with no confirmed impacts on Australia.
summary: No material change since the last check. Hormuz shipping attacks continue, though oil eased to about US$95 after the US signalled restraint. Australia relies on imported fuel, so this remains the main path to SA, but no current shortage or rationing was found. The Ebola (Bundibugyo) outbreak in Africa is serious but distant, and there are no SA weather emergencies.
actions: Keep the car tank and any generator fuel at least half full while Hormuz shipping remains disrupted.

categories.name: Geopolitical & conflict
categories.summary: The US-Iran conflict and Hormuz shipping attacks continue, with the US signalling restraint if a deal is reached. Chinese military pressure around Taiwan remains a background concern; no new direct threat to Australia found.

sources.title: Oil falls as Trump signals restraint on Iran amid fresh Hormuz shipping attacks (TimesLIVE, 9 Nov)

categories.name: Nuclear & fallout
categories.summary: Iran's nuclear programme is part of negotiations, but there are no signs of nuclear use or alerts. No nuclear-command aircraft seen airborne by the collector.

categories.name: Cyber & infrastructure
categories.summary: No current major Australian outage or attack found; the Telstra nationwide outage in search results dates from July. CISA items are routine and the ACSC feed timed out.

sources.title: CISA: hardening industrial refrigeration and cold chain systems

categories.name: Pandemic & biological
categories.summary: The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has passed 10,600 confirmed cases in DR Congo, with imported cases in Kenya and Nigeria. Serious but distant; risk to SA is limited to rare imported cases.

sources.title: WHO Disease Outbreak News: Bundibugyo virus disease (6 Nov)

categories.name: Natural hazards
categories.summary: No GDACS orange/red alerts. The M6.4 Solomon Islands quake produced no tsunami. No current SA severe weather or bushfire emergencies found.

sources.title: USGS M6.4 – 30 km WSW of Lata, Solomon Islands

categories.name: Fuel, food & supply
categories.summary: Hormuz disruption keeps fuel supply tight after this year's shortages and refinery fire, but no current shortage or rationing was found.

sources.title: Oil falls on open as Trump says fresh Iran attacks unlikely (Reuters via Investing.com)

categories.name: Markets & finance
categories.summary: Brent down 3.3% to about US$95, VIX easing to 23, gold near record at US$4,118, AUD at 0.690. Stressed but calmer today.
